card.name: Comparatives after verbs of achieving results
card.fires_on: The word "better" (also "more", "outstanding", "yields", "optimize") right after a verb like yield, achieve, experience or have, just before a result noun such as understanding, performance or control.

modes.label: Better before outcome noun
modes.description: "better" follows a verb of getting a result and precedes a noun like understanding, control or performance.
modes.example: may achieve<< better>> control. Angina Pectoris Total

modes.label: Intensifier before effect
modes.description: "more" or "outstanding" comes after "have a" and before an effect noun such as serious course or analgesic.
modes.example: can have a<< more>> serious or even fatal course in susceptible patients

modes.label: Result verbs
modes.description: Verbs like yields or optimize that lead into an improved-outcome phrase.
modes.example: pain management may<< optimize>> the treatment of chronic pain, as well

card.plain: It fires on words like "better" or "more" that come just before a result, such as better control or more serious course.
